title: AgentVersionActivated
description: A specific version of an agent became the active one. A fact: it states a transition, not the agent's current configuration.

agentId.description: Partition key. Stable for the life of the agent.

version.description: The version number that became active. Consumers wanting its configuration call back into agent-factory; this event only states that a transition happened.

occurredAt.description: When the activation happened in the domain, not when it was published.
